import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 5005;
    static final long inf = 1000000007L;
    static int n, m, startPoint, endPoint;
    static int[] a = new int[maxn];

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d, int e) {
            from = a; to = b; cap = c; flow = d; cost = e;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int n, m;
        List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[maxn];
        int[] inq = new int[maxn];
        int[] d = new int[maxn];
        int[] p = new int[maxn];
        int[] a = new int[maxn];

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        void init(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            e.clear();
        }

        void add(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            e.add(new Edge(from, to, cap, 0, cost));
            e.add(new Edge(to, from, 0, 0, -cost));
            int m = e.size();
            g[from].add(m - 2);
            g[to].add(m - 1);
        }

        boolean bellman(int s, int t, int[] flow, int[] cost) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
                d[i] = (int) inf;
                inq[i] = 0;
            }
            d[s] = 0;
            inq[s] = 1;
            p[s] = 0;
            a[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.offer(s);
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                inq[u] = 0;
                for (int i : g[u]) {
                    Edge ee = e.get(i);
                    if (ee.cap > ee.flow && d[ee.to] > d[u] + ee.cost) {
                        d[ee.to] = d[u] + ee.cost;
                        p[ee.to] = i;
                        a[ee.to] = Math.min(a[u], ee.cap - ee.flow);
                        if (inq[ee.to] == 0) {
                            Q.offer(ee.to);
                            inq[ee.to] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (d[t] == (int) inf) return false;
            flow[0] += a[t];
            cost[0] += d[t] * a[t];
            int u = t;
            while (u != s) {
                Edge e1 = e.get(p[u]);
                e1.flow += a[t];
                e.get(p[u] ^ 1).flow -= a[t];
                u = e1.from;
            }
            return true;
        }

        int minCost(int s, int t) {
            int[] flow = new int[1];
            int[] cost = new int[1];
            while (bellman(s, t, flow, cost));
            return cost[0];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        startPoint = 0;
        endPoint = n * 100 + 1;

        MCMF solve = new MCMF();
        solve.init(endPoint + 1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            solve.add(startPoint, 1 + (a[i] - 1) * 100, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                int p = (i - 1) * 100;
                solve.add(p + j, p + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            solve.add(i, endPoint, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                int p = (x - 1) * 100 + i;
                int pp = (y - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; j++) {
                    int costVal = (int)(d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1))) + c;
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                int p = (y - 1) * 100 + i;
                int pp = (x - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; j++) {
                    int costVal = (int)(d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1))) + c;
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve.minCost(startPoint, endPoint));
    }
}
